comment: mode = 'paper' (default, fake money) or 'live' (real money, requires keys + explicit opt-in)
symbol_config_comment: Per-symbol instrument overrides. Each entry can be a plain string (spot, leverage 1) or an object with type/leverage/etc. Types: 'spot' | 'futures' | 'forex'. Futures = USDT-margined perpetuals (Binance/Bybit). Forex = spot FX pairs.
default_instrument_comment: Default instrument applied when a symbol is not in symbol_config.
strategy_name_comment: Select a strategy: trend_pullback | rsi_mean_reversion | bollinger_bands | macd_crossover

exchange.note: Only needed for mode=live. NEVER enable withdrawals on this key. Add an IP allowlist. Note PH SEC access restrictions - read GUIDE.md section 2.

llm.note: The LLM writes a market briefing and critiques trades. It CANNOT place orders - see GUIDE.md section 4.

notify.note: Optional. Sends trade + alert messages to Telegram.
